subject.title: refactor: separate external conversations from local sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these conversation tools, Gateway RPCs, and persisted v11 delivery model as the permanent cross-transport boundary between local sessions and external conversations?
rationale: This creates durable product, protocol, plugin, and upgrade contracts whose long-term ownership and compatibility cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Adopt after live proof
options.body: Accept the architecture after the current head demonstrates live Reef correlation and safe v10 upgrade and recovery behavior.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Ship only the minimum Reef/session-loop correction while deferring generic public conversation APIs and durable delivery contracts.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the linked issue open while maintainers redesign the conversation and delivery ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the architecture after the current head demonstrates live Reef correlation and safe v10 upgrade and recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The self-assigned linked issue and protected PR identify this person as the clearest available sponsor for the product-contract decision.
